scripts.dev: concurrently --names Server,Site 'cd packages/server && bun run dev' 'cd packages/site && bun run dev'
scripts.licenses: mkdir -p packages/site/public && bunx generate-license-file --input ./package.json --output /tmp/licenses-root.txt --overwrite && bunx generate-license-file --input ./packages/site/package.json --output /tmp/licenses-site.txt --overwrite && bunx generate-license-file --input ./packages/server/package.json --output /tmp/licenses-server.txt --overwrite && bunx generate-license-file --input ./packages/service/package.json --output /tmp/licenses-service.txt --overwrite && cat /tmp/licenses-root.txt /tmp/licenses-site.txt /tmp/licenses-server.txt /tmp/licenses-service.txt > packages/site/public/THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt
